data.name: Melodie
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'melodia', meaning 'song' or 'melody'. Melodie is a name rich in musical symbolism, reflecting the harmonious and rhythmic nature of life. This name was traditionally given to girls who were believed to have a melodic voice or who were musically inclined.
